answer_sql:
SELECT
  'Purchased before 2023-12-31' AS customer_group,
  SUM(s.net_amount) AS revenue
FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line AS s
WHERE
  s.customer_key IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      customer_key
    FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line
    WHERE
      order_date < '2023-12-31'
  )
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'First purchased after 2024-01-01' AS customer_group,
  SUM(s.net_amount) AS revenue
FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line AS s
WHERE
  s.customer_key IN (
    SELECT
      customer_key
    FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line
    GROUP BY
      customer_key
    HAVING
      MIN(order_date) > '2024-01-01'
  )
